reviewer_harness_notes: The process-tree peak poller needed two reviewer-side fixes before use: (1) MSYS-vs-Windows PID translation abandoned for command-line anchoring; (2) the ancestor-chain exclusion initially used per-level CIM queries that delayed the first sample past short-lived smoke targets -- replaced by a single-snapshot walk; (3) a first draft self-matched its own command line and deadlocked a smoke task, which was stopped and never involved any product process. Final methodology: recursive child-tree WorkingSetSize sum over processes whose command line contains the run-unique basetemp marker 'post-m4-ninefile', poller and its bash ancestors excluded as roots; validated by marker smoke test (peak 26.8 MiB for a sleep process).

One reviewer diagnostic PowerShell invocation (orphan-poller check) mangled $_ through bash double quotes and produced a raw-1-style error flood; it was read-only, affected no product state, and is preserved here as a harness failure, not reclassified.

No optional rg condition was used; every verification step ran as a required command with native exits recorded. All three pytest reruns and both probes have empty stderr; streams sealed only after producer termination; the heavy run used the background lifecycle with poll-based completion.
